name: A2UI Atomic Catalog
description: MCP server for the A2UI Atomic Catalog: an agent composes real rendered interfaces from a fixed vocabulary of typed UI atoms — charts, gauges, steppers, dashboards — across web, Google Meet, Apps Script, Google Chat and MCP Apps hosts, instead of generating raw HTML.

skills.name: List catalogs
skills.description: List every A2UI catalog with a when-to-use, so an agent can pick the extension catalogs a surface needs.

skills.name: Get catalog
skills.description: Return one catalog's atoms (type + one-line description).

skills.name: Required catalogs
skills.description: Given an A2UI payload, return the catalog URIs it needs.

skills.name: Render to URL
skills.description: Render an A2UI payload in the caller's own renderer and return a live URL.

skills.name: Preview render
skills.description: Quick demo render on the public renderer — onboarding only, rate-limited.

skills.name: Render inline
skills.description: Render an A2UI payload as a live interactive view inside an MCP Apps-capable host.

skills.name: Build multi-page surface
skills.description: Build a multi-section app from raw title+content sections, auto-split across independently-encoded pages.

skills.name: Distill document
skills.description: Compile a training.md/roadmap markdown document into a live interactive app via a deterministic parser, no model involved.

skills.name: Graduate to standing app
skills.description: Emit a deterministic recipe to deploy a tested surface as a standing app in the caller's own Google Apps Script account.

skills.name: Emit training runbook
skills.description: Build a multi-lesson training surface as one page with real tab navigation between lessons.

skills.name: Emit runbook surface
skills.description: Stamp content through a declared, pre-authored composition (e.g. a study/curriculum hub) — zero layout decisions required.

skills.name: Publish short link
skills.description: Store a payload server-side (opt-in, one-week retention) and return a short shareable link.

skills.name: Unpublish link
skills.description: Delete a published short link before its retention expires.

note: This is a static discovery pointer, kept in sync by hand — not build-time generated from the live server. GET https://a2uicatalog.ai/mcp with a JSON-RPC tools/list call returns the live, authoritative tool list (including identify_model and render_ping, omitted above as internal/diagnostic). This describes an MCP server, not an A2A-protocol agent: supportedInterfaces.protocolBinding names the wire format (JSON-RPC over HTTP) honestly, not a claim of A2A JSON-RPC method conformance.
